title: US-short §5 Hard Veto 分层 governance — const-pins the severity-ordered veto tier ladder + the design's never-solo-veto safety list + the semantic-advisory-first policy
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §5 hard-veto severity ladder (entry_hard_veto > position_hard_veto > strong_downgrade > soft_risk_tag > shadow_record — ORDER = severity, const-pinned) so the batch-2 veto classifier and the field-registry operation_impact vocabulary (§10) cannot drift tier identity/effect/order; the §5.3 'must never solo-veto' safety list (none of these alone justifies a hard veto); and the §5.1b semantic-veto advisory-first policy. §5.2 candidate hard-vetoes are forward-calibration-gated and routed to §13.1 #7 (candidate_veto_calibration_item_id), not pinned. §5.1a reliable-trigger categories are batch-2 veto-classifier prose, intentionally NOT enumerated here (no half-pinned vocab). draft-07 cannot express: ladder byte-faithfulness to §5, the §5.3 list single-source, and candidate_veto_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

veto_tiers.description: §5 表 — severity-ordered ladder (strongest first), const-pinned {tier, effect} byte-faithful to design.

const.effect: 持仓强制重评/减/清（不是沉默）

must_not_solo_veto.description: §5.3 不应单独硬否决 — design-locked safety list; NONE of these alone justifies a hard veto.

semantic_veto_policy.description: §5.1b 正文语义/新闻类 — advisory-first; escalate only on reliable evidence.

candidate_veto_calibration_item_id.description: §5.2 候选硬否决 forward-calibration route → §13.1 #7 (攒触发+人工复核才升).
